text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shaking off Symboli Rudolf's "voice" in 
her head, Sirius Symboli triumphs in the 
Nippon Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, what awaited her upon returning 
to the academy was an invitation to become 
Symboli Rudolf's "traveling companion."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Weighing the pros and cons, Sirius Symboli 
swallows her pride and agrees. Amidst the 
rapidly shifting circumstances, she found 
herself aiming for the Kikuka Sho.
